why.description: Optional: why it matters to the user.

next_step.description: The very next physical action. Required when track is true.

due_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-02T09:00 (server time zone) or with an offset.

track.description: Suggest tracking it now (needs a free slot or a pending park proposal).

reason.description: Why you suggest this, in one or two sentences. Shown to the user next to the proposal.
